name: Between the Rivers
scope: Yes if it is an event of Sumer, Babylon or Assyria
boundary: Between the Rivers: Sumer, Babylon and Assyria; Persia from Cyrus on goes to Kings of Kings, sieges to Under Siege, Egypt to Pharaohs, Ashurbanipal's library to Places of Learning.
example_beats: Uruk becomes the first city (c. 3500 BC)
Sargon of Akkad founds his empire (2334 BC)
Sennacherib builds his Nineveh palace (700 BC)
